currentWork.title: FINAL.38 bounded highway adoption + fullscreen route persistence
currentWork.releaseStatus: Implementation is validated on PR #174 and awaits production merge/live verification. FINAL.37 remains the current production release until merge.
fieldEvidence: Real-device retest after FINAL.37 showed no practical change in highway selection.
Real-device retest also showed active route geometry disappearing in fullscreen MAP.
rootCause: FINAL.37 could generate via-IC HGV candidates, but final selection still forced them through the older near-fast +2 minute band, so a valid bounded highway candidate could be discarded and the surface route retained.

Fullscreen/soft-rotation viewport changes invalidated Leaflet size but did not explicitly redraw the active route layer after the iOS viewport settled; existing regression tests did not assert route persistence across fullscreen transitions.
scope: Active IC search remains driving-hgv with exact registered vehicle restrictions.
Active IC search is triggered until normal motorway use is materially sufficient (target up to 55% of primary route distance, capped at 18km), rather than stopping after a small fixed amount.
A via-IC candidate must contain meaningful motorway use (at least 1.5km and at least 15% of primary route distance).

If an active IC candidate is inside FINAL.36 global detour bounds (+20% time capped +8min; +30% distance capped +10km), the best active IC candidate is preferred without reapplying the old near-fast +2min filter.
Non-active ORS alternatives retain the near-fast ranking behavior.
Fullscreen and software-rotation viewport refresh explicitly redraws the active route after Leaflet size invalidation at two settle points.
No car/straight-line fallback and no weakening of HGV safety restrictions.

verification.activeIcAdoption: PASS: bounded active IC route outside the old +2min near-fast window is selected while inside global detour caps
verification.fullscreenRoutePersistence: PASS: active route is asserted visible before fullscreen, after fullscreen resize, and after software rotation
